text.tspan: GEST3015 orbital atlas — Si, TiO2, Eu3+ at 300 K
Beiser-level hydrogenic clouds · GEST3015 I–V · room temperature = 300 K
What I learned today
• L2 hybridization (Beiser 8.5): Molecular geometry follows valence-shell overlap: sigma along the bond axis, pi parallel to it. sp3
(tetrahedral), sp2 (trigonal planar + leftover p), and sp (linear + two leftover p) are linear combinations of s and p when that mixing lowers
the energy, as in CH4, C2H4 and C2H2. L2 also writes dsp3 / d2sp3 for PF5 and SF6 as geometry mnemonics.
• VSEPR vs MO / ligand-field for d-block: VSEPR and a single hybridization label are not the right language for TiO2. Ti(IV) is d0; the gap is O
2p (VB) to Ti 3d t2g (CB). e_g points at oxygen, t2g between. Use ligand-field / molecular-orbital theory, not 'd2sp3' as an electronic-structure
assignment.
• Periodic table bookkeeping: Atomic numbers must be stored, not inferred from the drawn table: the detached f-block made Hf look like Z=58. Hf
is 72. Block colour is the differentiating electron (s/p/d/f), not a hybridization map. Eu is an f-block lanthanide; Eu3+ is 4f6, 7F0.
• Silicon as a covalent crystal (Beiser 10.3, 10.6-10.7): Diamond-cubic Si is four equivalent sp3 bonds, a=5.431 A, nn=2.352 A, angle 109.47 deg.
The gap is indirect (VBM at Gamma, CBM along Delta toward X), Eg=1.12 eV at 300 K, so a phonon is required. ni ~ 1e10 cm^-3; Eg/kT ~ 43.
• Room temperature means occupation, not shape: kT(300 K)=25.9 meV=208 cm^-1. Orbital clouds do not change with T. Temperature enters Fermi-Dirac

from the ligands - see the radial panel. Do not assign sp3dn hybrids.

Scope: hydrogenic Z_eff clouds and idealised geometries. Not DFT, not XRD, not a hybridization map for d/f-block.
Panels: MATLAB R2026a on the course machine (overwrite svg/matlab_export/). Composer preview generator: Octave 8.4.0.
